Issue #553 narrow-viewport gate for every month bar consumer (6 surfaces x editorial/modern x 390, 360 and, since Issue #564, 320 px, with a whole-page element-geometry check). Needs only the tenant fixture, no seed, and no date dependency because the browser clock is fixed at 2026-09-16 (widest German month label). Measured RED on the unfixed tree: 21 of 24 fail (20 with the Heute button plus the modern /leave year bar at 360 px, where the nav row sits 1 px outside the bar); 24/24 green after the fix.

Issue #621 narrow-viewport gate for the shared .view-tabs strip (/admin/system with five tabs, /admin/vacation) x editorial/modern x 390 and 360 px: no page-level horizontal scroll, the five-tab strip scrolls itself (non-vacuous), End/Home bring the chosen tab fully into view with its underline unclipped. Needs only the tenant fixture, no seed, no date dependency. Measured before the fix: /admin/system 565 px and /admin/vacation 641 px wide at 390 px; after the fix 390 px in both skins (scripted probe against the rebuilt test stack).

Issue #563 browser proof of the tenant salon admin on the real test stack: PLANUNG navigation to the salon list, opening hours edited and persisted (reload plus GET /salons/:id), the header salon switcher appearing on create and disappearing on deactivation without a page reload (window marker), the Ketten-Paket hint replacing 'Salon anlegen' at the salon limit, admin/system reduced to the three shift-check radios with a PUT body of exactly shiftStoreHoursMode, the /shifts per-salon hint with two salons, and no horizontal page overflow at 390 and 360 px (measured 0 px on list and detail) with both time inputs of every editor row inside the row. Needs only the tenant fixture (every module booked, quota 500), one API-created shift-based admin contract and one API-created second salon, and exactly one intercepted /me/context; no seed, no date dependency. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 8/8 pass on the first complete run, 150/150 together with operator-console.spec.ts, and 16/16 with --repeat-each=2.

Issue #86 browser proof of the Personalabteilung view on the real test stack (6 tests). An API-created HR person (Mitarbeiter role plus the Personalabteilung template, TENANT) opens the employee list, a detail page with exactly the tabs Stammdaten, Arbeitszeit, Urlaub, Salons, the reports, the month close and the salon admin without one answer >= 400 and without one request to /time-entries, /day-breaks, /retro-entry-requests or /overtime/month-saldo; changes a contract from the next month-first, adds and ends an Einsatzsalon, sets an exit date, finds the ended person with the filter Ausgeschieden, sees counts instead of dates for another person's month-close gaps, and creates an employee with a chosen Stammsalon in a two-salon tenant. Four matrix tests (390/360 px x light/dark) fulfil the list, salon-assignment, contract-history and month-close answers through page.route and check four pages each (16 cells) with the whole-page geometry probe plus a clipped-content probe; they found a real clipped Salons tab (fixed in the same plan). Needs only the tenant fixture plus API-created employees and salons; every date is computed from the current day, so no date dependency and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 6/6 pass, whole e2e-ci selection 224 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts), 225 tests in 1.1 min.

Issue #70 browser proof of several time entries on one day on the real test stack (2 tests, browser zone pinned to the tenant's Europe/Berlin). A tenant with two active salons: a worker records 08:00-12:00 in the first salon through 'Neuer Eintrag' with the Salon field, then 13:00-16:00 in the second salon through 'Weiteren Eintrag an diesem Tag' from the edit dialog of the first entry (start preset 12:00); the list shows both rows with the Salon column naming each salon; the calendar cell of the day carries the tooltip '2 Einträge' and switches to the list focused on the day (two highlighted rows); a third entry 11:00-14:00 overlapping the first is refused with HTTP 409 and the server's text 'Überschneidung mit bestehendem Eintrag', the dialog stays open and the list still holds the same three rows; the cell of a day with exactly one entry (recorded through the API) still opens that entry for editing with its salon preselected. A tenant with ONE salon sees no Salon field, no Salon column, no per-day add and no switcher, and 'Neuer Eintrag' on a day with an entry still opens that entry (D-12). Needs only the tenant fixture plus one API-created second salon and API-recorded entries; every date is computed from the current day (weekdays inside the 10-day retro window, in the tenant's zone), so no fixed date and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 2/2 pass on the first run and on each of three further consecutive runs (4.1-6.0 s), whole e2e-ci selection 226 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts), 227 tests in 1.1 min.

Issue #92 browser proof of a trip between two salons on the real test stack (2 tests, browser zone pinned to the tenant's Europe/Berlin). A tenant with two active salons and a day with 08:00-12:00 in the first and 12:30-16:00 in the second salon (recorded through the API): the day's cell carries the tooltip '2 Einträge' and switches to the list; 'Weiteren Eintrag an diesem Tag' opens the ordinary form (Salon field, break editor); the switch 'Fahrzeit zwischen Salons' replaces the Salon field by 'Von Salon' / 'Nach Salon', hides the break editor and shows the hint 'Der Weg von oder nach Hause ist keine Arbeitszeit.'; Von = first salon, Nach = second salon, 12:00-12:30 is saved with HTTP 201 and the list of the day then holds three rows, exactly one with the badge 'Fahrzeit' and the route '{first} → {second}'; a second trip 07:00-07:30 from the second to the first salon (before any entry of the day, i.e. a way from home) is refused with HTTP 409 and the server's German text 'Der Weg von zu Hause oder nach Hause ist keine Arbeitszeit.', the dialog stays open and the list still holds three rows. A tenant with ONE salon is offered no switch and sees no badge. Needs only the tenant fixture plus one API-created second salon and API-recorded entries; the day is computed from the current day (a weekday inside the 10-day retro window, in the tenant's zone), so no fixed date and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 2/2 pass on the first complete run and on each of three further consecutive runs (3.2-3.8 s), whole e2e-ci selection 228 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts) in 1.1 min.

Issue #89 operator console against a mocked /api/v1/operator contract (page.route fulfils every operator request in the browser): no seed, no operator account, no date dependency (the session clock test uses the Playwright fake clock). The operator session is seeded into sessionStorage by the spec; one test uses the tenant-bootstrap fixture only to prove a tenant token never reaches the operator surface. Measured: 36/36 pass on the rebuilt test stack (108/108 with --repeat-each=3).
